summary: Eton Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing an October 13, 2026 license agreement with Aquestive Therapeutics granting exclusive U.S. commercialization rights to LIBERVANT (diazepam) buccal film for seizure clusters. Eton paid a $10.0 million upfront fee plus up to $47.5 million in regulatory/commercial milestones ($10M first sale, $2.5M ages 6-11 approval, up to $35M sales-based) and mid-teens royalties; Aquestive supplies exclusively for 20 years. The product holds tentative FDA approval. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch launch timing, full-approval conversion and sales-milestone risk.
